shared.loadErrorDescription: The record could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.
shared.optionsErrorDescription: The category, tag and author lists could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.

list.title: Posts
list.description: Create drafts, edit content and manage publication from each post’s page.
list.loadError: The post list could not be loaded. Check the connection and database access.
list.cardDescription: Only posts you can access are shown. Authors see their own drafts; editors and admins see all posts.
list.empty: There are no posts you can access yet.
list.footnote: In this increment, categories, tags and author profiles can only be chosen from existing records. Management screens will follow in a separate increment.

newPage.title: New draft
newPage.description: Enter the title, slug, excerpt, category, tags and ordered author credits. A draft stays hidden until it is published.
newPage.cardDescription: An author credit does not grant permission to edit or publish.

editPage.loadErrorTitle: The post could not be loaded

success.unpublished: Post unpublished and returned to draft.

editPage.publishedDescription: Published. Saved changes appear on the public page immediately.
editPage.publishedAtDescription: Published · {publishedAt}. Saved changes appear on the public page immediately.
editPage.draftDescription: A draft is visible only to editorial members. Publishing uses the last saved version and requires a category and, if there is a cover image, its alt text.
editPage.readOnlyDescription: Only editors and admins can edit a published post. An author credit does not grant edit permission.
editPage.unsupportedDescription: This post’s body was saved in a format this editor version does not support (version {version}). Editing is disabled to prevent data loss.
editPage.formCardDescription: Saving increases the revision number. If someone else edited the post while the form was open, saving will not silently overwrite their changes.

preview.loadErrorTitle: The preview could not be loaded
preview.draftNotice: This draft is visible only to editorial members. The public site, search and caches do not show this content.
preview.coverAltMissing: The cover image has no alt text; add it before publishing.

publish.title: Publish this post?
publish.description: “{title}” becomes public with its last saved version and appears on the home page, in archives, in search and in the feed. Unsaved changes are not published.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this post?
unpublish.description: “{title}” returns to draft; the public page, listings, search and the feed stop showing it immediately. You can publish it again later.

errors.forbidden: Only editors and admins can publish and unpublish posts.
errors.conflict: This post changed after the page was opened. Refresh the page and try again with the current version.
errors.category: Choose a category and save before publishing.
errors.cover: Enter alt text for the cover image and save, or remove the cover; a published cover needs a description for screen readers.
errors.body: The post could not be published because its body is invalid.
errors.state: The post’s status does not allow this action. Refresh the page.
errors.missing: The post was not found or you do not have access to it.
errors.rateLimited: Too many publishing actions in a short time (at most 30 per hour). Try again a little later.
errors.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.

form.languageHelp: For a language not in the list, type its BCP 47 code (e.g. fr, pt-BR, zh-Hant). The title, excerpt and body are marked with this language; the admin interface language does not change.
form.title: Title
form.slugHelp: Generated from the title if left empty. Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; this value appears in the URL.
form.bodyHelp: Use the arrow keys to move through the toolbar. Images need alt text; use the image button to edit the selected image. YouTube videos are added by link and need a title for screen readers.
form.categoryHelp: A category is optional for a draft but required before publishing.
form.noTags: No tags yet. Tag management will follow in a separate increment.
form.authorsHelp: Add them in display order. An author credit does not grant edit permission.
form.noAuthorProfiles: No author profiles. Author management will follow in a separate increment.
form.allAuthorsAdded: All authors have already been added.

languagePicker.searchPlaceholder: Language name or code (e.g. fr, pt-BR)
languagePicker.noMatch: No matching language. Type a valid language code: fr, pt-BR, zh-Hant.

unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. If you leave this page, they will be lost.

validation.slugMissing: A slug could not be generated; enter one manually.
validation.slugInvalid: Slug may contain only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
validation.languageInvalid: Choose or type a valid language code (e.g. fr, pt-BR, zh-Hant).
validation.coverAltTooLong: Cover alt text can be at most {max} characters.
validation.tagDuplicate: The same tag cannot be added more than once.
validation.creditAuthorMissing: Choose an author for each position.
validation.creditOrderRange: Author order must be between 0 and 999.
validation.creditDuplicate: The same author cannot be added more than once.
validation.creditOrderGap: Author positions must start at 0 and have no gaps.

actionErrors.bodyUnsupported: The post body contains unsupported content or an unsafe link.
actionErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission to edit this post.
actionErrors.rateLimited: Too many saves in a short time. Your changes in the form were kept; save again in a few minutes.
actionErrors.conflict: This post changed after you opened the form. Your changes in the form were kept; open the current version and apply them again.
actionErrors.slugTaken: This slug is already in use.
actionErrors.missing: The post was not found or you do not have access to it.
actionErrors.bodyInvalidField: The post body contains unsupported content.
actionErrors.coverAltRequired: The cover image of a published post requires alt text.
actionErrors.coverAltRequiredField: Enter alt text for the cover image.
actionErrors.coverAltInvalid: The cover alt text is invalid.
actionErrors.coverMissing: The cover image was not found or is not an image.
actionErrors.coverMissingField: Choose a valid image from the media library.
actionErrors.titleInvalidField: Title must be between 1 and 200 characters.
actionErrors.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
actionErrors.noSession: No session found. Sign in again.
actionErrors.noMembership: This action requires an editorial membership.
actionErrors.formInvalid: Some fields in the form need to be corrected.
actionErrors.createFailed: The draft could not be created. Try again.
actionErrors.revisionMissing: The form’s revision information is missing. Refresh the page.
